description:
The purpose of Amendment 1 is to provide responses to questions received, presentation, and particiaption list from the Industry Day held on 25 February 2026.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

CLOSED. The Huntsville Engineering and Support Center (CEHNC) USACE will host a Virtual Industry Day via TEAMs for the Medical Facilities Architect -  Engineer Servies (MFAES) 4.0 acquisition. The event will take place on 25 February 2026 with a start time of 1300 hours CST. This session will provide an overview of the technical requirements, acquisition strategy, and timeline for the upcoming procurement. 

Agenda:

  • Introduction
  • MFAES 4.0 Overview
  • Acquisition Approach
  • Small Business Resources
  • Safety
  • Questions and Wrap Up

Action Required:
Prospective contractors are encouraged to review and complete the attached Participation List prior to the event. Any questions before the event shall be sent to Eddie Williams @ eddie.williams@usace.army.mil and Johnna Sebben at johnna.m.sebben@usace.army.mil. A copy of the Industry Day presentation will be provided at a later date.
